join_order.notes: Use orders_o_orderkey_lookup dense_pk_array for O(1) lookup per qualifying lineitem row. No hash table needed.

scan_phase.description: For each surviving block, apply filters in selectivity order within the block

data_structures.shipmode_dict: load l_shipmode_dict.bin, resolve codes for MAIL and SHIP
data_structures.orderpriority_dict: load o_orderpriority_dict.bin, resolve codes for 1-URGENT and 2-HIGH
data_structures.aggregation: direct_array — int64_t counters[2][2] per thread (shipmode_idx × high/low), thread-local, sum at end

parallelism.description: Each thread claims surviving zonemap blocks. Per qualifying row: lookup o_orderpriority via direct_array index, increment thread-local counter. Final reduction sums all thread-local counters.

mmap_advice.orders_o_orderkey_lookup: MADV_SEQUENTIAL (probe keys are sorted by l_orderkey)
mmap_advice.orders_o_orderpriority: MADV_SEQUENTIAL (accessed via sorted row_ids from sorted orderkeys)

aggregation_detail.shipmode_idx_mapping: map MAIL code and SHIP code to 0 and 1 based on alphabetical order for correct output sorting
aggregation_detail.reduction: sum across all thread-local arrays after parallel phase

resource_scoping.description: Declare all MMap objects at outer scope before RAII timer. Destructors (munmap) fire after timing ends to exclude TLB shootdown cost.
